title: Schematic & crafting effect unlock data
description: Allows for blocks to unlock schematics and crafting effects without having to implement tetra interfaces. Uses the 'block' predicate to test blocks within 'bounds' of a workbench to determine what should be unlocked.

schematics.description: The schematics that are made available by this unlock.

effects.description: The crafting effects that are made available by this unlock.

block.description: Used to test for a block that must be present near the workbench for this unlock to be available.

bounds.description: The bounds in which a workbench can look for a block to match against this unlock. The bounds are defined as [minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ].
